banner.title: STARTING MONEY AND TABLE 45, printed capture pp. 75-76 - the OA funds round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. No contested cells detected within the single source: the T45 grid pins as ten class rows x 8 bounds - the ch'ien, tael, yuan and fen components each as a lo-hi pair, a 0-0 pair meaning the row has no such component; the tael amounts read as (ch'ao) - the R636 ch'ao-tael equality covers the note. The class row order pins as the 0-9 code: samurai, shukenja, monk, sohei, kensai, barbarian, bushi, wu jen, ninja, yakuza. The ninja footnote (the amount in addition to the other class cash) pins as a bool. The Gajin and Rates of Exchange prose with Table 46 (capture pp. 76-77) are deliberately left for the next round
